chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 548: The Realm War Begins — Ji Ning’s Final Stand
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning says goodbye to his pregnant wife Yu Wei as the Crimsonbright Realmverse launches a full-scale war against the Seamless Gate. The Xingtian army marches to battle.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 548 — A Father’s War
og_description: Ji Ning leaves his pregnant wife to lead a Xingtian army of 300,000 Immortals in the opening battle of a realm-spanning war.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 548 — The War Is Here
twitter_description: Ji Ning hides his True Immortal breakthrough and a new sword stance as he marches into a realm war that will decide the fate of the Three Realms.

lore_anchors.definition: A colossal war formation manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability, formed from thousands of Celestial Immortals and hundreds of thousands of Loose Immortals.
The next stage after Celestial Immortal, achieved by purifying the Golden Core into Pure Yang; grants dramatically increased power.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power; the foundation of arts like archery and soul techniques.
A compilation of unsystematic Heartforce application techniques from Old Man Yuan and other major powers, valued for its soul-coordination method that boosts controllable treasure capacity.
A Xianxia concept representing a realm's accumulated destiny and luck; losing it makes a world vulnerable to conquest, and protecting it is a strategic priority.
The ancient, slumbering overlord of the Seamless Gate who merged with the Heavenly Dao to survive the primordial war; now a part of the Dao itself, he cannot act with complete free will.
The tribulation faced by Fiendgod Body Refiners to become Empyrean Gods; considered far more dangerous and prestigious than the Heavenly Tribulation faced by Ki Refiners.
